correctness.rationale: The original named-base pair-type count follows from realizing each admissible finite diagram and applying homogeneity with each parameter fixed. An independent replay (`python3 /workspace/independent_replay.py graph`) traverses all triangle-free final graphs through order five and deletes each possible marked edge; it reproduces the 1, 9, 96 and 1410 eligible cases at orders 2–5, no ties and exactly the two negative classes of multiplicities 20 and 60. For the repaired exact star-family theorem, conditioning on the centre at k leaves gives I=2^k+1 and B=3^k+2·2^k. With x=2^m, y=3^m, the exact numerator of the odds change is y(2x+3)+x(−x²+2x+5). It is 31, 87 and 169 for m=1, 2 and 3, including the one-vertex-star convention. For m=4 division by x gives 214+3/16−256<0; thereafter every positive term in that bracket grows by at most three while 4^m grows by four, proving all remaining cases without extrapolating a finite test.
